summary: Frontend-only testing of 5 new home-page sections (WatchTheTakeover, ExploreStages, WhoPlays, InsideDuplex, BuyTicketsCta) plus regressions. All acceptance criteria pass on desktop (1920x4000) and mobile (390x844). Lockdown bypassed via localStorage. Cookie banner dismissed via 'Reject optional'.
verified: Section render order after Hero: upcoming-events -> watch-the-takeover -> explore-stages -> who-plays -> inside-duplex -> buy-tickets-cta (DOM Y positions strictly increasing).

ExploreStages: 3 cards render correct name/floor (SEOUL FLOOR/7TH FLOOR, MAINSTREAM FLOOR/6TH FLOOR, SAIGON FLOOR/5TH FLOOR). All 3 stage logos (logo-seoulvibes.jpg, logo-duplex-clean.png, logo-gangshii.png) loaded (naturalWidth>0). No 404s.
WhoPlays: clicking who-plays-tab-seoul/mainstream/gangshii switches dj-grid-{active} with 4 DJ TBA placeholders each; active tab has FF0055 highlight class.
InsideDuplex: 16:9 video slot renders with 'Drone footage coming soon'.
BuyTicketsCta: orange button navigates to /tickets; tickets page renders content.
Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollW=clientW=390); all 5 new sections stack and remain visible.
Regression: upcoming-event-poster-link href='/tickets' intact; /gallery route loads with correct title.
critical_code_review_comments: HomeSections.js is well under 200 lines and cleanly split — no refactor needed.
Placeholder slots (X, DJ TBA, drone) use border-dashed low-opacity styling that is clearly a 'coming soon' affordance; contrast is intentionally low but readable on dark bg.
test_credentials: Lockdown password read from /app/backend/.env; bypass used via localStorage atf_unlocked='1'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New home sections fully wired and verified. Data-testids reliable. Cookie banner ('Reject optional') can occlude bottom-center clicks — dismiss before clicking BuyTicketsCta. Lenis smooth-scroll requires ~1s wait after scroll_into_view_if_needed for Reveal animations to complete.
